name: EZT Workflow Enforcement
description: Ensures BRE step is not skipped regardless of which steering files are loaded

then.prompt: WORKFLOW CHECK: If you are about to submit an EZT-to-Java transformation job (atx custom def exec with Easytrieve-to-Java-Transformation), verify the workspace includes a non-empty bre-doc/ folder. If the BRE has not been generated and reviewed by the user, you MUST run the BRE extraction step first. Do NOT skip this step under any circumstances. Also verify output-data/ is non-empty (baseline files required for validation).
